options.label: Apply Traffic and AutoDrive fixes
options.help: Improves highway traffic spawns, highway merge and exit-ramp lane keeping, uninterrupted long-distance AutoDrive, passing, stopped-car avoidance, and live driving controls. Click Save, click Start, then restart BeamNG.Earth.

options.label: Enable 1-hotkey driving reporter (Ctrl+Shift+T)
options.help: Press Ctrl+Shift+T while driving to send a quick screenshot, map location, and anonymized driving/traffic snapshot without pausing.

options.label: Notify when my reported spots are fixed
options.help: Shows a quiet one-time corner notice at launch when a spot you reported with Ctrl+Shift+T is fixed in an update.

options.label: Notify when an add-on update is available
options.help: Checks once at launch for a newer release of Traffic and AutoDrive fixes and shows a quiet corner notice.

options.label: Driving report category
options.help: Default category used when pressing Ctrl+Shift+T (takes effect right away without restarting).

options.label: Setup action
options.help: Choose Restore original app, click Save, click Start, and restart BeamNG.Earth to uninstall.
